text:
Sam: Quick ask — can someone run a paged + FlashAttention fusion bench for `gpt-mini` across seq={512,2048} x batch={1,8,32} with fused-op ON/OFF? Need KV warm/cold. PR 1234 landed but want to guard perf. Need results by EOD PST if possible. cc @Jia @Omar

Jia: I can take the 512 runs this morning. Which infra queue should I use, rtx-paged or paged-large?

Sam: rtx-paged for 512 combos; paged-large for 2048/32. Use the bench script below and capture nsys + ncu summaries. Turn off continuous batching for these tests.

Sam: ```
./bench/run.sh --model gpt-mini --seq 2048 --batch 32 --paged \
  --flash-fuse {on,off} --kv-warm {cold,warm} --profile nsys \
  --trace-copy yes --continuous-batching off --seed 42 \
  --commit a1b2c3d --out /tmp/bench.csv
```

Omar: I can run 2048/32 after my current job. Confirm commit `a1b2c3d` and seed 42. Also please tag runs with `run_meta=paged+flash-fuse-v1`.

Lia: Quick question — the runner defaults to `--continuous-batching=on`. Sam said turn it off, correct? For isolating kernel perf we should disable it.

Sam: Yes, turn it off. For cold runs set `--cache-size=0`. For warm runs, do one priming request of length 256 before measuring.

benchbot: queued job 6721 on rtx-paged requested by @Jia

Jia: Starting 512 runs now (seq=512, batch=1/8/32). ETA ~40m. I'll upload nsys traces and CSV to the infra bucket when done.

Omar: Can we also capture device memcpy stats? Add `--trace-copy=yes` (looks like Sam already included it). I'll include `ncu --set full` for one repetition.

Sam: Yes include memcpy traces and one `ncu --set full` capture.

benchbot: job 6721 completed. summary CSV: fused_on p50=12.3ms p99=45.6ms; fused_off p50=14.8ms p99=60.2ms. raw outputs: gs://redwood-infra/bench/6721/

Jia: Uploading logs: gs://redwood-infra/bench/6721/nsys.qdrep and gs://redwood-infra/bench/6721/results.csv. Quick glance: fused ON improves p99 for 512, but cold p99 still notably higher.

Sam: Thanks. Omar — please run 2048/32 on paged-large with `--trace-copy` and `ncu --set full` and post to gs://redwood-infra/bench/6730/. Also capture SM/warp occupancy in nsys.

Omar: On it, starting now.

benchbot: queued job 6730 on paged-large requested by @Omar

Lia: FYI I observed kernel occupancy drop for seq=2048 with fused ON in a microbench — watch SM utilization in the traces.

Omar: First 2048 run finished. ncu indicates higher L2 traffic when fused ON. Raw -> gs://redwood-infra/bench/6730/ . Will run remaining reps then parse p99.

Sam: Can someone run `python tools/parse_bench.py --input gs://redwood-infra/bench/6721/results.csv --metric p99` and paste the p99 table here? Need a quick comparison.

Jia: Pasted parsed p99 for 512 runs:
fused_on: batch1 p99=46.1; batch8 p99=48.7; batch32 p99=52.0
fused_off: batch1 p99=60.2; batch8 p99=62.8; batch32 p99=68.9

Omar: 2048 results (prelim):
fused_on batch32 p99=220.4ms
fused_off batch32 p99=185.6ms
Looks like fuse regresses p99 for large seq / big batches — likely memory traffic or shared memory thrash.

Sam: Interesting — that's a regression for seq>=2048. Lia, can you check the kernel launch params and shared memory usage in the PR? Maybe `flash_kernel_v2` uses more shared memory and causes bank conflicts.

Lia: I'll re-run a microtrace with `nsys --sample=cpu` and inspect kernel shared memory / registers. Also will try toggling `flash_kernel_v2` and re-run one sample.

Sam: Please open a short perf/regression issue and tag the PR author. Also add a rollout guard: if p99 increases >10% for seq>=2048, automatic rollback.

Omar: Creating issue now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/1422 — added repro steps and links to gs://redwood-infra/bench/6730/.

Sam: Great. Summary: Jia & Omar leave raw traces + parsed CSVs in the bucket. Lia digs into kernel params. I'll add the numbers to the perf dashboard and update the rollout config. Thanks everyone — :thumbsup:
